notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
-T5 (insane) is Nmap's most aggressive timing preset — maximum parallelism, minimal retry waits, shortest RTT timeouts. Fastest possible scan but sacrifices accuracy: missed ports are expected on slow/unreliable networks.

=== TIMING TEMPLATES ===
T0 (paranoid): slowest, maximum evasion. T1 (sneaky): slow evasion. T2 (polite): slow, minimal impact. T3 (normal): default. T4 (aggressive): fast, reliable networks. T5 (insane): maximum speed, accuracy sacrificed.

=== VALIDATION ===
Always compare -T5 port count against a standard scan — save both with -oA, diff results. If port counts match, -T5 is acceptable for this network. Missing ports = slower timing needed.

=== USE CASE ===
Internal, high-bandwidth, trusted infrastructure where IPS is not a concern and time is limited. NOT for internet-facing or monitored environments.
